title: The Daily Five
dek: Five questions from this week's biggest stories in Israeli sport — from a Euroleague overtime classic to a Tel Aviv night of Muay Thai knockouts.

questions.question: What was the final score, after overtime, when Maccabi Tel Aviv beat Real Madrid in the 2014 Euroleague Final in Assago?
questions.explanation: Maccabi won 98-86 after overtime on 18 May 2014, with the score locked at 73-73 after regulation and Maccabi having beaten CSKA Moscow 68-67 in the semi-final two days earlier.

questions.question: Per odds reported by Sport5, what are Hapoel Tel Aviv's odds to win the 2026/27 EuroLeague title?
questions.explanation: Hapoel Tel Aviv are priced at 12.00, the fifth-best odds in the field, while Panathinaikos are favourites at 4.00 and cross-city rivals Maccabi Tel Aviv sit at 34.00.

questions.question: How much is Real Madrid's opening offer for Manchester City's Rodri reportedly worth, per ONE?
questions.explanation: ONE reported Real Madrid's opening bid at €50-60 million, below Manchester City's reported €80 million valuation of Rodri.

questions.question: Who won gold in the men's 100m breaststroke final at the 2026 Commonwealth Games, ahead of Adam Ramsay-Peaty's bronze?
questions.explanation: Australia's Sam Williamson won gold in 59.17 and Jersey's Filip Nowacki took silver in 59.34, ahead of Adam Ramsay-Peaty's bronze in 59.65; Holly Ramsay, his wife, is the daughter of chef Gordon Ramsay.

questions.question: Which fighter did Kibedy Gordon knock out in under a minute at GFN 1 in Tel Aviv?
questions.explanation: Kibedy Gordon knocked out former UFC bantamweight José Alberto Quiñones in under a minute in their Muay Thai bout at GFN 1 on 27 July 2026.
